title: Play and pause controls start and stop lesson playback
description: Verifies a student can start playback in the lesson view and then pause it with playback state remaining consistent.

steps.description: Click the control to advance to the next onboarding step
Select at least one favourite subject
Click a lesson in the recommended lessons list
Press play on lesson content to start playback
Press pause on lesson content to stop playback
Verify the playback state is consistent and does not continue advancing

title: First-time onboarding completion routes to personalized dashboard
description: Verifies a new student can complete all onboarding selections and is routed to the dashboard where personalized recommendations and progress are shown.

steps.description: Click the control to advance to the next onboarding step
Select at least one favourite subject
Verify the user lands on the dashboard
Verify personalized recommendations and a progress summary are displayed

title: Returning user is routed from entry to dashboard without onboarding
description: Verifies that after onboarding is completed once, revisiting the entry route skips onboarding and goes directly to the dashboard.

steps.description: Click the control to advance to the next onboarding step
Select at least one favourite subject
Verify the user lands on the dashboard

title: Open a recommended lesson from dashboard into lesson player
description: Verifies a student can open a recommended lesson from the dashboard and reach the lesson player with details and controls available.

steps.description: Click the control to advance to the next onboarding step
Select at least one favourite subject
Click a lesson in the recommended lessons list
Verify the user lands on the lesson view
Verify lesson details and playback controls are displayed

title: Dashboard displays personalized progress summary and recommended lessons
description: Verifies the dashboard renders the core personalized sections after a student profile is created.

steps.description: Click the control to advance to the next onboarding step
Select at least one favourite subject
Verify a progress summary is displayed
Verify a list of recommended lessons is displayed

title: Resume a recent lesson from dashboard into lesson player
description: Verifies a student can select a lesson from the recent lessons list and is taken to the lesson view to continue it.

steps.description: Click the control to advance to the next onboarding step
Select at least one favourite subject
Click a lesson in the recommended lessons list
Click the navigation control to return to the dashboard
Click the lesson in the recent lessons list to resume it
Verify the user lands on the lesson view
Verify the lesson player is ready to continue the lesson

title: Set difficulty before playback and start lesson with selected level
description: Verifies a student can choose a difficulty level before starting playback and the lesson reflects that difficulty setting.

steps.description: Click the control to advance to the next onboarding step
Select at least one favourite subject
Click a lesson in the recommended lessons list
Turn on a difficulty setting to pick an explanation level
Press play on lesson content to start playback
Verify the lesson explanation reflects the selected difficulty level

title: Recently viewed lesson appears on dashboard after leaving lesson view
description: Verifies that viewing a lesson causes it to appear in the dashboard’s recent lessons list after returning to the dashboard.

steps.description: Click the control to advance to the next onboarding step
Select at least one favourite subject
Click a lesson in the recommended lessons list
Click the navigation control to return to the dashboard
Verify a recent lessons list is displayed
Verify the recently viewed lesson is present in the recent lessons list

title: Adjust difficulty during playback updates explanation without breaking playback
description: Verifies a student can toggle difficulty while the lesson is playing and the explanation updates in real time without interrupting playback.

steps.description: Click the control to advance to the next onboarding step
Select at least one favourite subject
Click a lesson in the recommended lessons list
Press play on lesson content to start playback
Turn on/off the difficulty setting while playback is active
Press pause on lesson content to stop playback
Verify the lesson explanation updates to match the new difficulty during playback
Verify playback remains functional and ends in a paused state

title: Onboarding required-field validation blocks submission until completed
description: Verifies onboarding cannot be submitted with missing required fields and proceeds successfully after the missing selections are completed.

steps.description: Select only one required onboarding field
Verify required-field validation errors are shown for missing fields
Verify the user lands on the dashboard
